item.title: 🔵 Solidity Pro VS Code Extensions Steal Crypto Wallets, API Keys, and Credentials
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.

item.title: 🟠 New WordPress Pre-Auth XSS Could Lead to PHP Code Execution - Patch ASAP
item.description:
Why this matters: Could impact sign-ins/MFA/Conditional Access — watch for login issues.
